sequence.description: Protein sequence to format (uppercase 1-letter codes). Mutually exclusive with `fasta_path`.

fasta_path.description: Path to a FASTA file with one or more sequences. Each sequence becomes a separate Protenix input JSON.

name.description: Sequence/job name embedded in the generated Protenix input JSON. Filesystem-safe characters only.

count.description: Number of identical chain copies to include in the generated input JSON (e.g. set to 2 for homodimer prediction).

seeds.description: Model RNG seeds embedded in the Protenix input JSON.
